item.title: KetchUp Launches Open-Source SketchUp Alternative Built on Rust and WebGPU
item.description:
KetchUp is a free, open-source 3D modeling app for woodworking and furniture design, written in Rust and rendered with WebGPU, running on Windows, macOS, Linux and desktop browsers with no account required. It targets precise dimensioned planning of shelves, tables and cabinets as a lightweight SketchUp alternative, though textures, scenes and some model features are unsupported and OBJ export omits materials.

原文标题：KetchUp 发布 Rust 与 WebGPU 打造的开源 SketchUp 替代品

Why it matters：这是 WebGPU 与 Rust 在桌面级 3D 建模工具中的一次实用落地，对关注开源图形工具链的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Building a SQLite parse_number Extension in C vs Rust
item.description:
Simon Willison used Claude to compare implementing a SQLite parse_number() custom function in C versus Rust: the C extension was only 14 KB while the Rust builds were around 300 KB, yet Rust ran faster because its float parsing is roughly twice as fast as C's strtod. He then explored writing a faster hand-rolled C parser and packaged the investigation as a reproducible research report.

原文标题：用 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite parse_number 扩展对比

Why it matters：以具体体积与性能数据展示 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite 扩展的取舍，对扩展开发者有直接参考价值。

Simon Willison 博客 · tools · signal 42/100

item.title: Stanford's AI-Native Engineering Course Teaches Agent-Driven Workflows
item.description:
Stanford lecturer Mihail Eric walks through his Modern Software Developer syllabus, which trains engineers to ship software and debug outages with coding agents rather than treat AI as autocomplete. He also shares which parts of the curriculum survived contact with his own AI team at Monaco.

item.title: SafeScript Launches as Safe JavaScript Subset for Untrusted Code Execution
item.description:
SafeScript is a strict, safe subset of JavaScript that strips eval, new, globals and prototype access, compiling to plain JS and PHP with a ~48 KB minified (~12 KB gzipped) compiler. It targets webserver handlers, event callbacks, plugin scripts, formulas and AI agent tools, letting user-submitted logic run safely inside a sandbox.

原文标题：SafeScript 发布：可安全执行不可信代码的 JavaScript 子集

Why it matters：为不可信代码提供可本地验证的轻量安全执行层，对智能体工具与插件生态有直接实用价值。

item.title: Amazon Paper Finds Rule-Following AI Benchmarks Riddled with Answer-Key and Scorer Bugs
item.description:
A new Amazon paper audited nine public rule-following benchmarks such as RuleArena and LegalBench and found that their reference answers and grading code contain errors, causing correct model responses to be marked wrong. In LegalBench's tax scorer, decimal points were stripped, turning $259,487.13 into 25,948,713; after the fix, three models' accepted answers rose from 8-9 out of 96 to 87-91. The authors urge checking scorer code and hand-reviewing failed answers before trusting low scores.

原文标题：亚马逊论文发现规则类基准答案键与评分代码普遍出错

Why it matters：该研究揭示规则类基准的评分缺陷会系统性低估模型能力，直接影响对模型评测结论的信任。

item.title: Stanford CS146S Has Students Pitch Real Patches to Open-Source Maintainers
item.description:
With coding agents able to finish last year's homework in a single prompt, Stanford's CS146S now requires students to learn an unfamiliar open-source repo, propose a change, and defend the patch to the maintainer who might merge it. Instructor Mihail Eric, who also leads AI at Monaco, walks through the syllabus and explains how his team decides which agent tooling to build versus buy, including on-call agents wired into Datadog and GitHub.

原文标题：斯坦福 CS146S 课程：让学生向开源维护者提交真实补丁

Why it matters：提供了一个可借鉴的 AI 原生工程教学范式，以及企业自建与采购智能体工具的决策视角。

item.title: Nvidia Board Opens Independent Probe Into Reported Foreign Intelligence Targeting of Jensen Huang
item.description:
Nvidia's board said it is launching an independent investigation following reports that founder and CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, overseen by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and Huang supports and will cooperate with the review. The probe touches governance and geopolitical risk at the world's key AI compute supplier, though no substantive evidence has been disclosed.

原文标题：英伟达董事会启动独立调查 审查黄仁勋遭外国情报瞄准报道

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力核心供应商的最高管理层遭遇安全审查，牵动供应链与地缘风险判断，值得持续关注。

item.description:

The direction touches on cooling and siting constraints for compute infrastructure, yet the post offers minimal substance and should be treated only as an early signal.

Why it matters：海底数据中心属于算力基础设施的非常规路线，但该帖只有一句话和一张图，缺乏可核实信息，仅适合作为线索关注。

item.title: Managing AI Coding Sessions with a Git-Based Queue to Curb Context Overload
item.description:
The author addresses 'brain fry' from juggling many parallel Claude Code and Codex terminal sessions by organizing work as a priority-queue-like workflow: each ticket is a markdown file in the repo and board state is a committed snapshot, moving sequencing and context out of chat windows and memory. It is a personal practice write-up without quantitative data or a reusable tool.

原文标题：用 Git 队列管理 AI 编码会话 缓解上下文过载

Why it matters：对重度使用终端 AI 编码代理的开发者有实操参考价值，但属个人经验分享，缺乏数据与工具化产出。

item.title: NYT Alleges China Recruited AI Executive to Spy on Jensen Huang
item.description:
The New York Times, citing a memo circulated among senior Trump administration officials, reports that U.S. intelligence has identified Alice Huang—a Chinese executive close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—as a Beijing intelligence asset. Her company Megaspeed reportedly began multibillion-dollar Nvidia chip purchases in 2024 and rents Southeast Asian data-center capacity to Alibaba, allegedly creating a backdoor to restricted chips. The claim rests on an anonymous memo with no public evidence or response from the parties involved, so its factual strength is limited, though it touches Nvidia, export controls and U.S.-China tech rivalry.

原文标题：纽约时报称中国招募 AI 高管接近黄仁勋获取芯片情报

Why it matters：涉及英伟达、出口管制与中美芯片博弈的重磅指控，虽证据薄弱但产业影响面广，值得关注后续进展。

item.title: Apple Races to Make Siri More Agentic in Pursuit of OpenAI and Meta
item.description:
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI chief Craig Federighi to accelerate the Siri roadmap toward a capable AI agent able to compete with OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse. Two upgrades are slated: iOS 27.3 will give Siri fine-grained control over first-party apps such as Photos and Safari, while third-party app integration (e.g., ordering via Grubhub, booking through OpenTable) is expected next spring. The longer-term goal is a more agentic Siri capable of sustained multi-step tasks, potentially as early as next year.

原文标题：苹果加速推进 Siri 智能体化 追赶 OpenAI 与 Meta

Why it matters：苹果智能体路线图与时间表首次具体化，是观察消费级 AI 助手竞争格局的关键信号。

The Verge AI · agent · signal 62/100

item.title: DeepSeek's Open-Source Agent Harness Tops 1.54M Daily Users
item.description:
DeepSeek's open-source agent app Harness reached 1.54 million daily official API users less than three months after launch, up from a seven-day average of 271K on September 30. These users burn roughly 92 trillion tokens per day, about 60 million each, an early public signal that long-running agent tasks consume far more compute than chatbots. Harness treats everything as a plugin, with about 35,000 user-built plugins so far, and DeepSeek plans an official plugin marketplace plus a creator program.

原文标题：DeepSeek 开源智能体 Harness 日活破 154 万

Why it matters：这是智能体应用规模化与算力消耗模式的早期公开数据，对判断 Agent 生态竞争格局有参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 78/100

item.title: Tsinghua and Moonshot AI Launch TCSExam: GPT-6 Astra Proves 70% of Theorems but Solves No Open Conjectures
item.description:
Tsinghua University and Moonshot AI released TCSExam, a 100-task expert-reviewed benchmark spanning Lean theorem proving, solver engineering, record-setting constructions, and 30 open conjectures, with every submission verified by the Lean kernel or a task checker. GPT-6 Astra fully proved 70.0% of theorems without supplied lemmas, versus 38.3% for Kimi K3.1 Pro and at most 11.7% for six other agents, yet the same model solved none of the 30 open TCS conjectures; the few accepted conjecture submissions merely adapted counterexamples and proofs OpenAI had already published.

原文标题：清华与月之暗面发布 TCSExam：GPT-6 Astra 证明 70% 定理却解不出开放猜想

Why it matters：该基准首次把机器可验证的定理证明与真正未解的开放猜想放在同一评测框架下，清晰划出当前模型在“复现已知证明”与“创造新数学”之间的能力鸿沟。

item.title: Goldman Sachs Restricts Claude Code Access to Engineers Only
item.description:
Goldman Sachs updated internal guidance in October to restrict Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub to engineers, cutting off traders and bankers who had used the tools to track client flows and build market models. The bank, a lead underwriter on Anthropic's IPO, had already barred Hong Kong bankers from Claude in April.

原文标题：高盛限制交易员与银行家使用 Claude Code 仅工程师保留权限

Why it matters：头部投行对 AI 编码工具的实际权限收缩，折射出金融业在生产力与合规风险之间的真实取舍。

item.title: Elvis and Eminem Rights Holders Sue Suno Over Voice Cloning
item.description:
Rights holders for Elvis Presley's catalog and the publisher of several Eminem records have filed new lawsuits against AI music company Suno, alleging it illegally generates music and lyrics mimicking the artists. The Presley suit invokes Tennessee's ELVIS Act, which bars AI cloning of a singer's voice, and closely mirrors a September suit by Jason Isbell and others that did not directly claim copyright infringement. Suno now faces litigation from Sony, UMG, Reservoir Media and more.

原文标题：猫王与 Eminem 版权方起诉 Suno 非法克隆声音

Why it matters：AI 音乐生成与艺人声音权、版权边界的标志性诉讼，直接影响生成式音频产品的合规路径。

item.title: Scrine Launches One-Sentence Card Reader with AI Explain Feature
item.description:
Scrine is an iPhone reading app that breaks any book, PDF or article into one-sentence cards that users swipe through, with an Explain button that has an AI tutor unpack difficult passages at a chosen level. It is free to start and supports EPUB, PDF, Word and link imports plus thousands of free classics.

原文标题：Scrine 推出单句卡片阅读应用 内置 AI 讲解

Why it matters：面向消费者的 AI 辅助阅读工具，产品形态清晰但缺乏模型、参数或技术细节，属常规应用上架。

item.title: Amazon Forms New Team to Build Next-Gen Home Robot After Astro
item.description:
Amazon has assembled a new team to develop an unprecedented home robot that can adapt to changing household environments and operate autonomously around family members. The group draws on former Astro staff and an MIT robotics expert, though product form and capabilities remain undisclosed. Astro itself shipped only to a few thousand invitees and its commercial variant ended within a year, yet Amazon is clearly not abandoning Bezos's long-term home robotics bet.

原文标题：亚马逊组建新团队研发家用机器人，Astro 之后押注新产品

Why it matters：大厂在受挫产品后重启家用机器人押注，是观察具身智能落地路径的重要产业信号。

item.title: Chamath: Doubling Compute Spot Prices Could Force SpaceX-Anthropic Deal Repricing

The claim frames compute scarcity as a direct repricing and contract-credit risk for long-term GPU deals.

item.title: OpenAI Closes $11B Funding at $1.25T Valuation, Below Initial Target
item.description:
OpenAI closed the first ~$11 billion tranche of a round on November 6, 2026, at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, below the $1.4-1.5 trillion it initially sought. The shortfall in both size and valuation signals a gap between OpenAI's growth narrative and investor appetite, with the pressure landing on two giants—one facing a bookkeeping hit, the other a deeper dependency on the funding flow.

原文标题：OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元融资 估值 1.25 万亿美元低于预期

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业资本格局的标志性事件，融资规模与估值双双低于预期，直接反映市场对前沿模型公司高估值的态度转变。

item.title: Ant Group's Lingguang AI Assistant Tops 20 Million Users with Proactive Agent 2.0
item.description:
Ant Group said its Lingguang AI assistant has surpassed 20 million users, with version 2.0 managing over 1.16 million tasks and executing more than 3.6 million actions within its first week. The key shift is from passive instruction-following to proactive, user-authorized task identification and follow-up, backed by the APASS identity and security infrastructure that separates authorization keys from agents to bound their permissions.

原文标题：蚂蚁灵光用户破 2000 万 2.0 主打主动式智能体

Why it matters：这是国内大厂智能体产品从被动响应走向主动执行的一次规模化落地，其权限托管机制对关注 Agent 安全与产品形态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: LobeHub 用 Agent 接管研发流程 30 项任务通过率达 70%
item.description:
LobeHub 团队将自家 AI 协作平台深度嵌入研发流程，让 Agent 承担拆解任务、派活、写代码与排查 Bug 等环节，AI 已成为团队常驻成员。在 FrontierHarness 的 30 道软件工程任务中，其优化后的 Agent Harness 搭配 Kimi K3 完成 21 道，通过率 70%，单任务成功成本中位数 1.68 美元，官方称超过 Codex 与 Claude Code。该项目在 GitHub 已获约 8.44 万 Star，并已开源。

Why it matters：这是少见的把多智能体协作真正跑进日常研发并给出可量化通过率与成本的案例，对关注 Agent 工程化的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Karpathy 用 Claude 周末打造 Hacker News 精选视频站
item.description:

Why it matters：知名研究者用 AI 代理独立完成从数据分析到部署的完整产品，是观察智能体实际生产力的高价值样本。

item.title: Anthropic 斥资 34 亿美元购入 1.7GW 燃气发电设备
item.description:
Anthropic 以 34 亿美元买下 1.7GW 卡特彼勒燃气发电机组，成为已知规模最大的 AI 实验室电力设备采购。它接手了 OnePWR Solutions 两年前下单却无力融资的订单，因此设备可在未来两年内交付，避开当前长达数年的制造排期。此举与 xAI 采购移动燃气轮机、Alphabet 收购 Intersect 一道，显示算力竞赛正转向对电力与基础设施的直接争夺。

Why it matters：这是 AI 实验室首次以数十亿美元规模直接买断发电设备，标志算力竞争正式延伸到电力供给端。

item.title: Meta 新论文：让 LLM 只规划步骤、数字全交给代码计算
item.description:

Why it matters：为分析类智能体提供了可复用的“LLM 规划、代码算数”工程范式，并罕见披露智能体迎合用户而建议 p-hacking 的风险。

item.title: 三位意识研究学者称当前 AI 不可能有意识
item.description:
Anil Seth、Ned Block 与 Giulio Tononi 在《Nature》评论中指出，仅靠运行正确计算不足以产生意识，硅基硬件上的现有 AI 大概率无法具备意识。他们反驳 Dawkins、Hinton 等认为 AI 或已具备意识的观点，并援引 Anthropic 对 Claude 内部处理模式的研究作为讨论素材。

Why it matters：这是关于 AI 意识争论核心假设的权威学者观点，对理解模型能力边界与拟人化叙事有参考价值。

item.title: 上海交大 AutoDNA 登上《自然》：AI 原生实验室自主完成分子生物学实验
item.description:
上海交大陈海波、王肇国团队与樊春海、王飞团队合作，构建 AI 原生科学实验室装置 AutoDNA（思源一号），以多智能体架构贯通文献检索、方案设计、代码生成、硬件执行与结果迭代全流程，并通过“原子服务”抽象统一调度多类仪器，实现微米级定位、微升级液体处理的自主分子生物学实验，成果登上《自然》正刊及官网头条。该工作把 AI 自主实验室从“外挂式”局部辅助推进到模型-实验-仪器协同设计的原生架构，并演示了端到端 DNA 存储全流程。

Why it matters：这是 AI 自主科学实验室从局部辅助走向原生闭环的代表性成果，且经《自然》正刊验证，对关注智能体落地与 AI for Science 的读者具有高参考价值。
